saints.name: St. Norbert
saints.title: Bishop and Founder
saints.shortBlurb: A worldly cleric converted by a brush with death, who became a great preacher and founded the Premonstratensians…
biography: Born at Xanten in the Rhineland about 1080, Norbert lived an easy life as a courtier-cleric until, thrown from his horse in a storm, he took the near-fatal shock as a summons to conversion. Ordained and giving away his goods, he became a wandering preacher of penance and, in 1120, founded a community of canons at Prémontré who followed the Rule of St. Augustine — the Premonstratensians, or Norbertines.

Called against his will to be Archbishop of Magdeburg, he labored to reform the clergy and was a strong defender of belief in the Real Presence against the errors of Tanchelm. He died at Magdeburg in 1134 and was canonized in 1582.
saints.knownFor: Founding the Premonstratensian canons; devotion to the Eucharist.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 6 June
